turns.question: What was the median order value on 1 October 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer here has no median order value metric (Median order value (EUR) exists only in the BigQuery dialect, not in this warehouse), so I cannot give that figure; the closest metrics are Average order value (EUR) (average_order_value_eur, revenue over non-cancelled orders) and, for its parts, Revenue (EUR) (revenue_eur) and Orders (orders_total).
